items.q: Do you remove all types of tires, including car and truck tires?
a: Yes! We remove all tire types, passenger cars, SUVs, trucks, ATVs, farm equipment, and more., from single tire pickups to commercial fleet removals. All sizes and conditions accepted.

items.q: How do you dispose of old tires?
a: We partner with recycling facilities that shred tires for repurposing into playground surfaces, rubberized asphalt, and other products. Functional tires get donated to community projects. Nothing goes to landfills.

items.q: How much does tire removal cost?
What areas do you serve for tire removal?
a: We service GTA and surrounding areas. Contact us with your location for confirmation.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day tire pickup?
a: Absolutely! Same-day service is available for urgent requests, subject to availability. Most clients get next-day pickup when available when booking before noon. {{fact:scheduling}}

items.q: Do you recycle or repurpose used tires?
a: Usable tires go to urban farms, playgrounds, and nonprofits. We provide recycling certificates for commercial clients upon request.

items.q: Is there a limit to how many tires I can dispose of at once?
a: No limits! We handle everything from single tires to 1000+ tire cleanouts. Large commercial jobs receive dedicated dumpsters and scheduled pickups.

items.q: Do I need to remove rims before tire removal?
a: Not required! We provide free rim removal (steel/alloy). {{fact:changedScope}}. Our team brings professional demounting tools to every job.
